name: ERP 仓配分销值守团队
description: 仓配分销舰队模板：巡检岗按仓逐日触发日终账实对账与单据巡检（只读），核对岗逐条定性四类差异（缺失/多余/金额不符/状态不符）并以 pending 提案回写，拍板岗持确认门裁决落账或拒绝留痕；三岗错峰06:10/06:40/07:20。装包后经壹座「团队 → 从模板实例化」建队。边界：作业执行在外部（客户 WMS / 承运商系统 / 客户财务系统），编排层零写外部系统；外部系统未接通如实 NOT_WIRED；资金归集/代收代付/分账一律拒绝（二清红线）。
notes: 舰队模板 pack：装包后经壹座「从模板实例化」建队；persona 禁含花括号字面量；fleetContext 只入 cadence.promptTemplate；成员 target 指向 supply-chain-recon-roles 包的三名岗（id 与本模板 agents 同名，一套词汇）；引用名对齐 registry 在册名；确认门只在拍板岗（边界审计同口径）；铸造前须人工评审（边界/错峰声明），铸造+首轮真跑走壹座生产。publish-ready 源清单，未上架（packId 未铸造）。

en.name: ERP Warehousing & Distribution Duty Team
en.description: Warehousing and distribution fleet template: the inspector triggers the daily book-vs-physical reconciliation and document inspection per warehouse (read-only), the reconciler qualifies each of the four difference classes (missing / extra / amount mismatch / status mismatch) and writes back a pending proposal, and the decider holds the confirmation gate to post or reject with a recorded reason; posts stagger at 06:10 / 06:40 / 07:20. Install, then instantiate from the template. Boundaries: reconciliation runs on a read-only beachhead with zero writes to external systems; WMS and carrier portals are role bindings chosen by the customer.
en.notes: Fleet template pack: install, then start manually (new fleet is born paused); the first round is read-only. Posts stagger at 06:10 / 06:40 / 07:20; confirmation gate on the decider only; per-post tool faces narrowed via resources.mcpTools; the pack now also carries a team-console declaration (team/kpi/stream/decisions/spend). Personas carry no literal braces; fleetContext only in cadence.promptTemplate.
